Each feedback event modifies the posterior distribution over user churn probabilities, enabling dynamic survey deployment. The user experience optimization primitive aggregates these feedback signals into a scalar utility function, optimizing for engagement and retention. Operational autonomy emerges from the cumulative effect of autonomous feedback processing, reducing reliance on centralized decision-making. These primitives form a closed-loop system where each component influences the others through shared telemetry channels and state transitions. Failure modes include data contamination from production environments, incorrect assumption of Markovian behavior, and misalignment between feedback signal and user intent. The system must maintain strict separation of concerns between telemetry ingestion and action execution to prevent cascading failures.
